items.actClause: AN ACT to amend the public authorities law, in relation to providing for the financing and interior restoration of capital facilities for a certain not-for-profit corporation
items.memo:
BILL NUMBER:S432

TITLE OF BILL:
An act
to amend the public authorities law, in relation to providing for the
financing and interior restoration of capital facilities for a certain
not-for-profit corporation

PURPOSE OF THE BILL:
To enable the Nightingale-Bamford School to
enter into contracts through the Dormitory Authority in order to
refinance certain loans and finance certain capital expenditures
relating to restoration work to the interior of the school buildings.

SUMMARY OF SPECIFIC PROVISIONS:
Section 1 Amends paragraph (b) of
subdivision 2 of section 1676 of the public authorities law by adding
a new undesignated subparagraph including the Nightingale-Bamford
School in the list of entities deemed to be a "dormitory".

Section 2 amends subdivision 1 of section 1680 of the public
authorities law by adding a new undesignated paragraph including the
Nightingale-Bamford School in the list of entities deemed to be an
"educational institution."

JUSTIFICATION:
Founded in 1920, the Nightingale-Bamford School is an independent
school for girls serving students in K-12. The school embraces
rigorous academics as well as the arts and athletics, leadership
opportunities, and community service. The Nightingale-Bamford School
is committed to diversity in an educational environment of
responsibility, mutual respect, and empathy. Currently, twenty-three
percent of students receive scholarship grants to attend the
Nightingale Bamford School.

The School seeks authorization to meet its financing and refinancing
needs through the Dormitory Authority of the State of New York
(DASNY). In addition to refinancing existing obligations, this bill
will provide The Nightingale-Bamford School with the ability to
undertake needed interior renovations its buildings.

FISCAL IMPLICATIONS:
None.

EFFECTIVE DATE:
This act shall take effect immediately.

summary: Provides for financing and interior restoration of capital facilities for the Nightingale-Bamford School.
